user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Luxor controller's Wi-Fi/LAN module.

data_description.color_groups: Selected groups get full color control. Each one is given its own color slot on the controller (group 1 uses slot 250, group 2 slot 249, and so on) so changing one group's color doesn't change others.

letter.description: Facepack slot A–Z. Leave empty to use the first free one.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: Add a row per group: the group's light, its brightness in this theme and, for color fixtures, a color slot (0 none, 1–250 saved colors, 251–260 color wheels; empty keeps the group's current color). Groups not listed are left alone when the theme is applied.

save_current_as_theme.name: Save current lights as theme
save_current_as_theme.description: Saves every group's current brightness (and color) into a theme. Give an existing theme to overwrite it, or a new name to create one.
